items.title: Wipro nears record date for Rs 15,000 crore share buyback. What’s ahead for IT major’s 26 lakh shareholders?
items.description: Wipro's Rs 15,000 crore share buyback, priced at a premium, is nearing its June 5 record date. Retail investors can potentially achieve double-digit returns over 2-3 months, with brokerages projecting high acceptance ratios based on past trends and lean retail shareholding.

items.title: Coal India’s Rs 5,000 crore OFS opens for retail investors today: Should you buy or avoid?
items.description: Coal India's Rs 5,000 crore offer is now open for retail investors. Analysts see this as a good chance for long-term investment. The government is selling a portion of its stake. Institutional investors have already shown strong interest, bidding significantly higher than the floor price.

items.title: Q-Line Biotec shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Q-Line Biotech is poised for a strong stock market debut on Friday. Investor demand appears robust, with grey market trends showing a significant premium. The company's shares are expected to list at a higher price than the IPO issue price. Q-Line Biotech operates in the diagnostics and healthcare products segment. This positive sentiment highlights investor interest in the healthcare sector.

items.title: Autofurnish to make its debut on BSE SME platform today. Check GMP and other details
items.description: Autofurnish is poised for its stock market debut on Friday, with initial grey market signals suggesting a neutral investor sentiment. The automotive accessories manufacturer's IPO, which opened for subscription in late May, saw its shares priced at Rs 41. Proceeds from the Rs 14.6 crore issue are earmarked for working capital and general corporate needs.

items.title: Bio Medica Laboratories shares to debut today. Here's what GMP suggests ahead of listing
items.description: Bio Medica Laboratories' shares are set to list on the NSE SME platform amidst weak grey market sentiment, with the IPO currently trading at a discount. The Rs 52 crore IPO, which saw overall subscription of 2.26 times, aims to fund loan repayment and manufacturing expansion. Despite selective institutional interest, investor caution prevails due to broader market volatility.

items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 11 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMAs (Daily Moving Averages) on May 27, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. items.title: Ace investors take a hit on portfolios in March quarter
items.description: Top Indian investors saw their portfolios shrink in the first quarter. Hemendra Kothari and Mukul Agrawal experienced over 25% declines. Madhusudan Kela's holdings fell 21%. The portfolios of Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's family and Anil Kumar Goel were least affected. This period marked a sharp market downturn impacting many.

items.title: Stocks in news: RIL, Coal India, IDFC First Bank, Zydus Life, ONGC
items.description: Markets traded subdued with the India VIX correcting nearly 15% this week, though this hasn't significantly impacted benchmark index movement. RIL announced its AGM for June 19, 2026, while Coal India's government offer-for-sale will exercise the oversubscription option. Bharat Dynamics reported a 58.5% YoY drop in Q4 FY26 net profit, contrasting with Ashok Leyland's 14% YoY rise.

items.title: GIFT Nifty signals muted start for Dalal Street amid cautious trade
items.description: Indian markets traded flat on Wednesday, influenced by derivatives expiry and geopolitical tensions. Analysts suggest a cautious recovery hinges on stable crude oil prices and receding energy supply concerns. However, renewed US-Iran tensions and military strikes have revived geopolitical risk premiums, narrowing the path for further gains.

items.title: IDBI Bank stake sale back on table; Centre explores revival options
items.description: The bids remain ‘alive’ and the government is examining legal provisions under the tendering framework that allows for bids to be accepted even if offers are below the reserve price, said the people cited above.

items.title: Coal India OFS gets good demand amid green energy risks
items.description: Coal India's offer for sale opens for retail investors amidst a conflicting investment narrative. While the state-owned miner boasts strong financials and a consistent dividend track record, concerns over its long-term prospects due to the global shift towards renewable energy persist. Non-retail investors showed strong demand, subscribing 8.14 times on the first day.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv lines up Rs 2,000 crore for AI, cybersecurity and quantum technologies
items.description: Bajaj Finserv is launching Finserv Intelligence, a ₹1,500-2,000 crore, five-year initiative to build scalable technology solutions for India and the world. The program will invest in early-stage startups and collaborate with academic institutions to develop capabilities in AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies, aiming for transformational medium-term research.

items.title: Steel giants set for Rs 75,000 crore capex push in FY27
items.description: JSW, Tata, SAIL, JSPL are set to hike capex up to 65%; spending surge defies West Asia cost pressures.

items.title: Supreme Court seeks govt, RBI response to plea for audit of banks' realty exposure
items.description: The Supreme Court has asked the government and the Reserve Bank of India for their response to a petition that wants banks' dealings with real estate projects to be reviewed. The court also wants an investigation into developers accused of misusing homebuyers' money. Several authorities and builders have been issued notices.
